targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', at) AS time, agent AS metric, count(*) AS calls FROM monitoring.tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Error rate and p95 latency, by tool

targets.rawSql: SELECT server, tool, count(*) AS calls, round(avg(is_error::int) * 100, 1) AS error_pct, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS p95_ms FROM monitoring.tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
